thermal module: 160x120 VOx uncooled, 17 um pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 50 mK, thermal FOV 110 x 82
people-number exception and presence detection; healthy tracking (out-of-bed abnormal behavior)
temperature exception alarm for fire prevention, measurement -10 to 200 C, accuracy +/-8 C

release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD1017-1 is an indoor thermal presence detector using a 160x120 thermal module to count people and detect presence without capturing identifiable video, protecting privacy in offices, classrooms and nursing rooms. It also performs fire-prevention temperature alarms and can drive a relay for lighting or HVAC control.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal-only stream.
